findings.claim: When the re-ask call itself fails (reviewer does not answer the second time), Launch returns the second call's error rather than the first refusal; the spec (S7) says a reviewer that does not answer returns the first error as today (the original *ReplyRefusedError), so callers mapping refusal to exit 2 will instead see exit 1 with a different error, and no test covers a reviewer error on the second call.

The re-ask quotes refusal text (%v of refused.Err) into the next brief; that text can echo reviewer-controlled strings (e.g. an unknown member name), which is low-risk since the reviewer is already trusted with the brief, but it is unbounded and unescaped.

evidence: Read engine/review/app/launch.go lines 44-88 in the worktree; brief passed to reAsk already includes the frozen context when WithFrozenContext is on, so the re-ask carries it as required
Checked shapeRefusals list against the spec: all six named errors present
Checked tests cover successful re-ask, second refusal, binding refusal, and byte bound; no test covers reviewer error on the second call
